gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kulim-park: Open, unshaded and distinctive, Bellota Text commands the top, while Kulim Park, a friendly sans-serif, leaves generous gaps inside its e. Distinct up top, approachable below, and nothing fights for attention.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-spectral: Bellota Text draws a wire-like line with no shading. That wire line carries the display punch; Spectral, a text serif, does the quieter work with a soft thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cardo: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace holds a ruler-drawn line, while Cardo, a text serif, keeps its stroke softly varied. One announces, the other settles in and reads.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-sura: Ruler-straight and loud, Bruno Ace heads the page, with Sura, a serif, offering comfortable stroke contrast just beneath it. Paragraphs would read with a traditional, authoritative air, never rushed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-carme: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a long thread. Carme then keeps things modern and quiet, its open counters letting the stretched-out display line stay the star.
gen-gf-carme-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy, bookish serif strokes with a faint taper, sitting under Carme, whose clean lines never show a hairline. Bookish warmth against crisp contemporary clarity is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-cause-fs-plein: Plein reads clear and reliable, a sans with an open channel into every round letter, under Cause, a friendly handwritten heading. Pages stay light and inviting, suited to brief text.
gen-gf-cause-montserrat: Cause writes with a hand-drawn looseness and an e opened wide, while Montserrat, a geometric sans, glides along below. Reading it feels approachable, with lots of white space around every curve.
gen-gf-charm-fs-literata: Charm huddles its letters together in a casual, hand-drawn way, every stroke carrying the same visual weight. Literata, a serif, is sophisticated and bookish, though meant for brief text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-roundo: Blunt, unfinished bowls give Comic Relief its bold swagger. It commands attention up top, while Roundo, a geometric sans, keeps every small counter unclogged and the lowercase n tidy.
